scope: Complete 147-entry current FDA 4.7 source inventory. An entry does not imply its check is implemented, applicable to every submission or externally qualified.
severityPolicy: FDA High maps to Error, Medium to Warning and Low to Info in the project report; official severity is retained independently. These levels do not predict FDA receipt decisions.

rules.description: eCTD submission missing us-regional.xml file
rules.problem: You have submitted an eCTD submission without the required us-regional.xml file
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit with us-regional.xml file
rules.guidanceSource: The eCTD Backbone Files Specification for Module 1, ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Exact target-sequence m1/us/us-regional.xml file presence. Historical, surrounding, wrong-case and wrong-path files or directories do not satisfy this check; XML content validity is assessed separately. Selected regression and review tracked separately.

rules.description: Single file submission
rules.problem: You have a submitted a single file
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit folder containing file(s)/subfolders
rules.guidanceSource: FDA Presentations

implementation.note: Explicit direct-file versus directory/ZIP role is bound to complete stable preflight evidence; a one-member container does not fail this rule.

rules.description: Submission containing no files
rules.problem: Submission does not contain files
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit folder containing file(s)/subfolders
rules.guidanceSource: The eCTD Backbone Files Specification for Module 1, ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Preflight supports empty directory/ZIP containers before sequence selection, using complete safe scanning and stability verification; unavailable or interrupted inputs never prove absence.

rules.description: Application Mismatch
rules.problem: Application Type/Number in the FDA Form does not match Application Type/Number in us-regional.xml
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit using consistent Application Type/Number between FDA Form and us-regional.xml
rules.guidanceSource: FDA Presentations

implementation.note: Official requirement inventoried; existing project checks have not yet established complete coverage of this authority rule.

rules.description: Submission is not in eCTD format
rules.problem: You are required to submit in eCTD format
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit using eCTD format
rules.guidanceSource: Providing Regulatory Submissions in Electronic Format – Certain Human Pharmaceutical Product Applications and Related Submissions Using the eCTD Specification

implementation.note: Official requirement inventoried; existing project checks have not yet established complete coverage of this authority rule.

rules.description: Fillable form not included
rules.problem: You have submitted without including the appropriate fillable form 356h, 2252, 1571, or 2253 (CBER only)
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit with the appropriate fillable form 356h, 2252, 1571, or 2253
rules.guidanceSource: Providing Regulatory Submissions in Electronic Format – Certain Human Pharmaceutical Product Applications and Related Submissions Using the eCTD Specification

implementation.note: Official requirement inventoried; existing project checks have not yet established complete coverage of this authority rule.

rules.description: Invalid leaf element operation
rules.problem: You have submitted a leaf and did not include the operation attribute. The system substituted "New."
rules.correctiveAction: If the operation attribute should not have been "New," submit two new leaves. The first leaf should delete the leaf submitted without the operation attribute. The second should associate the file referenced by the first leaf to the leaf you had originally intended to modify.
rules.guidanceSource: DTDs; ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Explicit operation presence in captured target ICH and US leaf elements; missing, blank or defaulted values fail. Unknown explicit values and incomplete parsing remain NotEvaluated; DTD and lifecycle validity are separate. Selected regression and review tracked separately.

rules.description: Application form and cover letter should be "New"
rules.problem: You have submitted a form or cover letter using an operator other than "New."
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary as occasionally there is a need to replace an incorrect document. Modify your SOPs to ensure the "New" operator is used with forms and cover letters except for exception cases.
rules.guidanceSource: FDA Presentations

implementation.note: Checks explicit operations in correctly rooted target FDA form/cover-letter sections with unique XML observations and rules/assets/limits binding. Missing/duplicate/cyclic/over-budget ancestry remains unknown and known failures survive later unknown evidence. Actual main-form/attachment identity, full scope and corrective-document replacement exceptions remain unqualified.

rules.description: Extraneous leaf element path
rules.problem: You have specified a hlink:xref path for an operation that does not require one, e.g., "Delete."
rules.correctiveAction: Modify your SOPs to ensure extraneous information is not submitted.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Nonempty xlink:href on an explicitly delete target leaf. Only target backbones are assessed; unknown or defaulted operations and incomplete XML cannot establish a pass. Selected regression and review tracked separately.

rules.description: Extraneous modified leaf element path
rules.problem: You have specified a modified-file path for an operation that does not require one, e.g., "New."
rules.correctiveAction: Modify your SOPs to ensure extraneous information is not submitted.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A 36 #4

implementation.note: Nonempty modified-file on an explicitly new target leaf. Only target backbones are assessed; unknown or defaulted operations and incomplete XML cannot establish a pass. Selected regression and review tracked separately.

rules.description: Leaf element path length exceeds maximum (230 characters)
rules.problem: There is a maximum path length of 230 characters. Internal processing adds additional characters to your paths which may invalidate your links.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary. Examine your naming conventions to reduce the length of path statements.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Official requirement inventoried; existing project checks have not yet established complete coverage of this authority rule.

rules.description: Leaf element path contains invalid characters: backslash(\), colon(:), asterisk(*), question mark(?), less than(<), greater than(>), pipe(|), or space ( )
rules.problem: Your path statement contains invalid characters. Since the restriction on characters in the path is an operating system constraint there is likely to be an orphaned file caused by a mismatch between the path specified for the leaf and the actual path of the file referenced by the leaf.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit a corrected leaf in a future submission with the operation attribute of "Replace" to replace the original erroneous leaf.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; FDA Portable Document Format Specifications

implementation.note: Detects explicit unnormalized local href path defects before the first query/fragment delimiter in complete rooted current ICH/US backbones, with unique XML and exact rules/assets/limits binding. Suffix contents neither hide known path defects nor supply path defects. Distinguishes default/unavailable/conflicting raw values and bounds ancestry, indexing and findings. URI scheme, percent-encoded paths, query/fragment validity, delete leaves, historical sources and other XML scopes remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted. Third-round six-class Windows regression 201/201 including 111 FDA1102 cases and bounded main-agent read-only review passed without subagents. Remains Partial.

rules.description: More than one version of the us-regional.xml file exists
rules.problem: More than one us-regional.xml was found in the same sequence; the M1 element contains two leafs for regional files.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit with only one us-regional.xml and only one reference to a regional file per submission sequence.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Counts same-sequence files and M1 references independently and requires a complete target index for a passing observation.

rules.description: Missing required file
rules.problem: A required file in the UTIL folder is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary. Modify your SOPs to prevent this in the future.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; ICH Q&A 36 #2, 6, and 8

implementation.note: Checks ICH main DTD and capture-bound actual STF roots with observed conditional DTD/declared stylesheet/qualified valid-values dependency. Conditional evidence requires unique XML and rules/assets/limits binding, unique candidate path and bounded actual root identity; declaration-only or conflicting candidates remain unknown. Independent known failures survive later unknown evidence without requiring DTD Pass. Third-round six-class Windows regression 153/153 and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents. Creation-time ICH stylesheet and unresolved or historical utility variants remain open; status remains Partial.

rules.description: Required file checksum value in the util folder must match the expected checksum
rules.problem: You have submitted a required file which has been altered (DTD or stylesheet in the UTIL folder).
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to prevent this in the future and ensure the required file is not altered.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A 36 #2, 6, and 8

implementation.note: Checks published MD5 for ICH main DTD, identified STF DTD 2.2 and stylesheet 2.3, and recognizes valid-values 6.0 using the explicitly versioned official webpage checksum. Conditional evidence requires capture-bound actual STF roots, unique XML/rules/assets/limits binding and bounded identity; declaration-only or conflicting candidates cannot authorize corruption findings. Third-round six-class Windows regression 153/153 and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents. Unknown variants and creation-time ICH stylesheet remain open; status remains Partial.

rules.description: Omitted leaf element path
rules.problem: You have not provided the path to the file that should be referenced by the leaf.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit the leaf specifying the file path to the original document in a later submission. Use the operational attribute of "Replace" to replace the original incorrect leaf.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; ICH Q&A 36 #13

implementation.note: Missing or blank XLink href for explicitly new, append or replace target leaves. Checking the referenced file, path syntax and modified-file history is separate.

rules.description: Missing modified file
rules.problem: The leaf referenced in the modified-file element cannot be found.
rules.correctiveAction: In your next submission submit a leaf modifying the leaf that generated this error using the operation attribute of "Delete." In the same submission resubmit the leaf that generated this error correcting the modified-file reference.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Lookup of the referenced XML and leaf ID in selected sequence bytes. Incomplete target XML or unavailable history yields NotEvaluated.

rules.description: A leaf referenced in the modified-file element was not originally submitted to all applications in the grouped submission
rules.problem: You are using an operator attribute on a leaf that has been found in a different application, but has not been submitted to this application.
rules.correctiveAction: In your next submission, submit a leaf modifying the leaf that generated this error using the operation attribute of "Delete." In the same submission, resubmit the leaf that generated this error correcting the modified-file reference.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Official requirement inventoried; existing project checks have not yet established complete coverage of this authority rule.

rules.description: Omitted leaf element modified file path
rules.problem: The file path is not specified.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit the missing file path in a later submission referencing the original document using the operation attribute of "Replace."
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A 36 #4; ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Explicit replace, append and delete target leaves require a nonblank modified-file attribute.

rules.description: File name contains invalid characters: tilde(~), forward slash(/), backslash(\), colon(:), asterisk(*), question mark(?), single quote('), double quote(") less than(<), greater than(>), pipe(|), or space( )
rules.problem: The file name contains invalid characters.
rules.correctiveAction: Modify your SOPs to ensure file names do not contain invalid characters.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Actual captured target-sequence filenames, without URI decoding, against the explicit FDA forbidden-character set. Nonportable names refused by input capture never produce a passing FDA result; their rejection remains an input prerequisite. Selected regression and review tracked separately.

rules.description: File name exceeds maximum length (64 characters) per eCTD specification
rules.problem: The file name exceeds maximum length (64 characters).
rules.correctiveAction: Modify your SOPs to ensure files names do not exceed the maximum length (64 characters) per the eCTD Specification.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Captured target-sequence filenames including extensions; independent of XML parsing. Historical inputs are not reclassified by this current rule. Exact archived FDA source and bound selection date required. Selected regression and review tracked separately; no Formal/external qualification.

rules.description: File size exceeds maximum limit (400 MB) per eCTD specification
rules.problem: The file size exceeds the maximum limit (400 MB). Note: This limit may not be applicable if your file is a dataset. Please refer to the Study Data Technical Conformance Guide for current information regarding dataset file sizes.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. You should generally avoid sending files with sizes that exceed the eCTD Specification.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: General size screen for captured target files. Ordinary PDF prefix I/O and access failures leave that file unknown while preserving other known size failures in either manifest order; input-integrity exceptions and cancellation propagate. Third-round four-class Windows regression 108/108, including 36 size cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents. Precise byte convention, additional large file formats and dataset-specific applicability require further evidence. The archived October 2026 Study Data Technical Conformance Guide discusses dataset splitting in section 3.1.2.

rules.description: Invalid file extension
rules.problem: You provided a file extension that is not allowed in this section.
rules.correctiveAction: Only certain file extensions are valid in certain sections, therefore it is important to submit extensions only in the sections in which they are allowed. Corrective action may be necessary based on where the file with the invalid extension appears in the submission. You will be contacted if corrective action is necessary.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; Specifications for File Format Types Using eCTD Specifications

implementation.note: Selected module-level rows for current ICH M2-M5 under archived FDA format 9.3 include SVG in M3-M5 and RMD/JSON/CAS/DAT in M5. Actual XML module governs placement with unique capture/rules/assets/limits-bound XML, a captured ICH root, consistent explicit leaf attributes and bounded unique parent/child ownership. Missing, duplicate, cyclic or conflicting observations remain unknown without erasing independent known failures. Third-round six-class Windows regression 169/169 (47 new evidence cases) and bounded main-agent read-only review passed without subagents. Regional/subsection placement, remaining formats, permissible uses, archive-copy requirements and earlier revisions remain unqualified; still Partial.

rules.description: Leaf element title leads or ends with a space
rules.problem: Leaf element title leads or ends with a space.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to ensure that leaf element titles do not lead or end with a space.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Original target-sequence leaf title elements; leading/trailing ASCII space and missing/nonblank title checks. Duplicate/complex title structure, incomplete parsing or exhausted finding budget remain NotEvaluated. Historical inputs retain their own rules. Selected regression and review tracked separately.

rules.description: Omitted leaf element title
rules.problem: You have omitted the title of a leaf element.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit a replacement leaf element in a later submission referencing the original leaf using the operation attribute of "Replace."
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A 36 #20; ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Original target-sequence leaf title elements; leading/trailing ASCII space and missing/nonblank title checks. Duplicate/complex title structure, incomplete parsing or exhausted finding budget remain NotEvaluated. Historical inputs retain their own rules. Selected regression and review tracked separately.

rules.description: File does not contain a file extension
rules.problem: You have provided a file that does not have a file extension such as .pdf, .xpt, etc.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit a replacement leaf element in a later submission referencing the original leaf using the operation attribute of "Replace."
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Captured target-sequence filenames including extensions; independent of XML parsing. Historical inputs are not reclassified by this current rule. Exact archived FDA source and bound selection date required. Selected regression and review tracked separately; no Formal/external qualification.

rules.description: No leaf element for file
rules.problem: You have submitted the file(s) listed in the validation report without a corresponding reference in the backbone.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit, corrective action is based on the underlying reason for the error. If the error is the result of a simple omission of a leaf element, then you should ensure the leaf element file is included in the submission before resubmitting. If the error occurred due to a difference between the name of the file in a leaf reference and the actual name of the file, then you should correct the leaf element before resubmitting.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A 36 #13; ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; eCTD Comprehensive Table of Contents Headings and Hierarchy

implementation.note: Validates exact target module file paths against leaf references in the complete captured target backbones. ICH Q&A 36 item 13 defines the module and util folder scope.

rules.description: Non-required file exists
rules.problem: You have submitted files in the UTIL folder that are not required.
rules.correctiveAction: Modify your SOPs to ensure that only required files are placed in the UTIL folder.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A #51

implementation.note: Recognizes captured utility assets by exact path and bytes and reports Finder metadata. Ordinary metadata I/O and access failures remain unknown without discarding independent known failures; shared finding priority remains bounded, and input-integrity exceptions and cancellation propagate. Third-round five-class Windows regression 100/100, including 17 new read-failure cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents. Other regional support artifacts and miscellaneous files need additional assessment.

rules.description: Folder contains no files or sub folders
rules.problem: Your submission includes a file folder that contains no files or sub folders.
rules.correctiveAction: Modify your SOPs so that you do not submit empty folders in the future.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A #54

implementation.note: Captured target-sequence directories containing neither files nor subfolders. Parent folders with child directories are not empty. Surrounding inputs are not silently adopted; directory findings have no downloadable file address. Selected regression and review tracked separately.

rules.description: No file for leaf element
rules.problem: You have referenced the file(s) listed in the validation report from the us-regional.xml or index.xml files without providing the actual file(s).
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit, corrective action is based on the underlying reason for the error. If the error is the result of a simple omission of the file, then you should ensure the file is included in the submission before resubmitting. If the error occurred due to a difference between the name of the file in a leaf reference and the actual name of a file, then you should correct the leaf element before resubmitting.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A 36 #12; ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; eCTD Comprehensive Table of Contents Headings and Hierarchy

implementation.note: Checks target backbone references against exact captured file paths; unavailable history and unresolved paths remain unevaluated. Cross-sequence permission is separate from existence.

rules.description: Attribute value leads or ends with a space
rules.problem: Attribute value leads or ends with a space.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to ensure that attribute values do not lead or end with a space.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks explicit current backbone/STF values before DTD type normalization, with unique exact XML/rules/assets/limits binding, current paths, unique document/element/leaf indexes and bounded traversal. Defaults remain excluded; incomplete/raw-unavailable/inconsistent evidence stays unknown while known failures survive. Final seven-class Windows regression 204/204 including 33 binding cases and bounded main-agent read-only review passed without subagents. Other XML scopes remain unqualified; still Partial.

rules.description: Required attribute value omitted in M2 - M5
rules.problem: You did not specify a required attribute in a heading element or STF XML file in m2 through m5, e.g. 'indication' in the section 5.3.5 element or 'type of control' in the STF XML file for a study in section 5.3.5.1.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary. If corrective action is necessary, you will be contacted by FDA. Modify your SOPs to ensure that attributes are used as described in the eCTD Specification.
rules.guidanceSource: DTDs; The eCTD Backbone File Specification for Study Tagging Files V2.6.1

implementation.note: Checks four qualified ICH heading chains using unique current XML bound to capture/rules/assets/limits, captured ICH roots and bounded consistent parent ownership. Missing, duplicate, cyclic or conflicting heading facts remain unknown while independent known failures survive; a known missing heading attribute does not require DTD Pass. Known STF category policy remains unchanged and only qualified backbones reach that consumer. Third-round six-class Windows regression 158/158 including 32 new binding cases and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents. Duration applicability, regional variants and complete STF attribute qualification remain open; status stays Partial.

rules.description: An attribute appears multiple times in the stf.xml file
rules.problem: You have duplicated an attribute, e.g., two 'type-of-control' attributes in a STF XML file. Viewer will ignore duplicate attributes and display only the first attribute.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary. If corrective action is necessary, you will be contacted by FDA. Modify your SOPs to ensure that attributes are used as described in the eCTD Specification.
rules.guidanceSource: DTDs; The eCTD Backbone File Specification for Study Tagging Files V2.6.1

implementation.note: Checks duplicate known study categories per current STF with unique exact XML/rules/assets/limits binding, unique document/element indexes, exact locations and bounded traversal. Duplicate observed facts are not duplicate business categories, and known failures survive later unknown evidence. Final seven-class Windows regression 203/203 including 33 binding cases and bounded main-agent read-only review passed without subagents. Unknown category/realm and other business-attribute scopes remain unqualified; still Partial.

rules.description: Extraneous attribute
rules.problem: You have submitted an attribute that is not called for in the specification, e.g. 'manufacturer' in a Module 4 or Module 5 heading element or 'species' in a Module 5 STF.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is currently possible. Modify your SOPs to ensure that attributes are used as described in the eCTD Specification.
rules.guidanceSource: DTDs; The eCTD Backbone File Specification for Study Tagging Files V2.6.1

implementation.note: Checks ICH headings and known STF categories plus explicit ICH leaf/node-extension attributes under qualified actual section chains. Heading scope now requires unique current XML/rules/assets/limits binding, captured actual ICH roots, unique nodes and bounded consistent parent ownership. Conflicting observations and unavailable explicit attributes remain unknown while independent known failures survive. Existing content scope and STF category policy are unchanged. Third-round eight-class Windows regression 221/221 including 33 new heading binding cases and bounded main-agent read-only review passed without subagents. Regional, other content/STF scopes, unknown realms and duration outside qualified examples remain unqualified; still Partial.

rules.description: Checksum value must match the actual checksum
rules.problem: Your checksum value does not match the actual checksum.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action is based on the underlying reason for the error. You should determine if the issue is simply a miscalculation or misapplication of a checksum; if so, no corrective action is necessary. If you determine that the incorrect file was submitted you should submit the corrected file in a future submissions with a leaf element referencing the original leaf with an operation attribute of "Replace." If you believe that an error has occurred and that the file you have submitted may have become corrupt you should contact your appropriate Center representative.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Compares target ICH/US leaf and index MD5 declarations with captured bytes, including STF files and explicitly supplied history. Algorithm names are case-insensitive without trimming. Fixed STF DTD has no internal checksum attribute; unavailable or invalid comparison evidence remains unevaluated.

rules.description: Invalid checksum formatting in index-md5.txt.
rules.problem: You are using an invalid checksum format, i.e., you have not specified the 32 characters produced as part of generating the MD5 checksum, or you have included trailing spaces or carriage returns.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to ensure the proper MD5 checksum format is used.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Checks target index-md5.txt for exactly 32 ASCII hexadecimal bytes. Missing or unreadable files remain unevaluated; checksum matching is separate.

rules.description: Invalid checksum type
rules.problem: You have used an invalid checksum type.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to ensure the use of MD5 checksums.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Checks explicit target ICH/US leaf algorithm names for MD5 without trimming, including leaves referencing STF files. Fixed STF DTD has no internal checksum-type attribute; missing declarations and unread backbones remain unevaluated.

rules.description: Omitted checksum value
rules.problem: You have omitted the checksum value.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to ensure that the MD5 checksums are specified.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Checks missing/blank target ICH/US content-leaf checksums; delete is excluded. Unknown operations and unsupported XML scopes remain unevaluated.

rules.description: Unexpected checksum value
rules.problem: You have provided a checksum when the leaf operation is "Delete."
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to ensure that the checksums are not specified for delete operations.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2

implementation.note: Checks nonempty target ICH/US delete checksums, including whitespace. Missing/empty values do not trigger this rule; DTD completeness remains separate. Fixed STF DTD has no internal checksum or operation attribute. Unknown operations and unread backbones remain unevaluated.

rules.description: Omitted DTD version in index.xml file
rules.problem: You have omitted the DTD version in the index.xml file.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary unless FDA notifies you that it is unable to process your submission. Modify your SOPs to ensure that the DTD version is specified in the index.xml file.
rules.guidanceSource: The eCTD Backbone File Specification for Study Tagging Files V2.6.1

implementation.note: Checks the target index root explicit DTD version, distinguishing DTD defaults from supplied attributes. Complete retained root facts survive later XML errors; unavailable or ambiguous root facts remain unevaluated. Historical and regional roots are not target index declarations.

rules.description: Omitted DTD version in us-regional.xml file
rules.problem: You have omitted the DTD version in the us-regional.xml file.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary unless FDA notifies you that it is unable to process your submission. Modify your SOPs to ensure that the DTD version is specified in the us- regional.xml file.
rules.guidanceSource: The eCTD Backbone Files Specification for Module 1

implementation.note: Checks explicit DTD versions on all target selected US regional roots. Defaults prove omission even after later read failure; incomplete selection and unavailable or ambiguous roots remain unevaluated. Historical and unselected files are excluded.

rules.description: Company name is missing
rules.problem: You have omitted the company name in the us-regional.xml file.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary unless FDA notifies you that it is unable to process your submission.
rules.guidanceSource: DTDs; The eCTD Backbone Files Specification for Module 1

implementation.note: Second bounded M1 batch: company presence and within-document grouped consistency only. No vocabulary, cross-sequence activity or external qualification.

rules.description: Unsupported DTD version in index.xml file
rules.problem: You are using an unsupported DTD version in the index.xml file.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit your submission using a version of the DTD that is supported. You may resubmit using the original sequence number of the submission.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; FDA eCTD Website

implementation.note: Official requirement inventoried; existing project checks have not yet established complete coverage of this authority rule.

rules.description: Unsupported DTD version in us-regional.xml file
rules.problem: You are using an unsupported DTD version in the us- regional.xml file.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit your submission using a version of the DTD that is supported. You may resubmit using the original sequence number of the submission.
rules.guidanceSource: The eCTD Backbone Files Specification for Module 1; FDA eCTD and Module 1 Website

implementation.note: Official requirement inventoried; existing project checks have not yet established complete coverage of this authority rule.

rules.description: Node-extension exists
rules.problem: You have included node extensions in your submissions. Node extensions are strongly discouraged by FDA.
rules.correctiveAction: Modify your SOPs to ensure that node extensions are not used in future submissions.
rules.guidanceSource: FDA Presentations

implementation.note: Reports target ICH/US node-extension elements including nested and optional-ID nodes. Retained presence survives later read failure; incomplete selection cannot establish absence. Foreign namespaces and history are excluded; fixed STF DTD has no node-extension.

rules.description: Node-extension does not have a title
rules.problem: Node extension is supplied without a title.
rules.correctiveAction: In a future submission, a leaf should be provided that references the original node-extension leaf specifying the "Delete" operation. A new leaf using an existing eCTD heading should be also submitted specifying the operation attribute of "New" taking care to include all required elements and attributes. The use of node extensions is strongly discouraged.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks direct unqualified title-element presence on target ICH/US extensions. Descendant and foreign titles cannot supply it; empty titles still exist. Incomplete documents cannot establish final absence, while other complete-document failures remain reported.

rules.description: Node-extension title leads or ends with a space
rules.problem: The node-extension title begins or ends with a space.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to ensure that node extensions are not used in future submissions. The use of node extensions is strongly discouraged.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks exact U+0020 boundaries on direct simple target ICH/US extension titles. XML-decoded text is not trimmed or decoded again; incomplete text preserves reliable leading failures but does not prove final trailing characters.

rules.description: Application type is invalid
rules.problem: The application type must match a valid, supported application type from the specification and/or attribute xml file if applicable.

Existing AcroForm values and XFA packet/data nodes deliberately do not establish form template identity, field binding or rendered/semantic application number. Arbitrary field names, default values or raw XFA text cannot supply that meaning. Needs versioned form-field mapping, exact regional application association, and a qualified trans BLA exception fact; do not exempt all BLA applications or infer non-trans status from absent evidence. No implementation or qualification claimed; remains NotAssessed.

rules.description: Multiple application forms present for the same application
rules.problem: You have submitted more than one application form for the same application.
rules.correctiveAction: In future submissions, include only one file with the form number as part of the file name. For example, only include one file named 356h.pdf for an NDA, and do not include 356h in the file names of other ancillary documents.
rules.guidanceSource: FDA Presentations

implementation.note: Implements the corrective instruction's filename-marker component: distinct current PDF-named files containing 1571 or 356h, in qualified regional form groups with a unique exact application type/number association, produce an Info finding. Repeated references including URI aliases count once; different applications/types do not mix. Fixed DTD, capture/context, connected raw XML facts and unique non-default explicit operation/href values matching each counted leaf are required. Attribute enumeration uses the work budget; unqualified leaves do not hide other independent duplicate files. Actual form identity, other numbers/locations, unreferenced files, historical lifecycle and shared multi-application groups remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted. Final seven-class Windows regression 216/216, including 59 FDA5032 cases with 15 new raw-leaf cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents.

rules.description: Application form placed in wrong TOC location
rules.problem: You have submitted an application form that was not placed in the correct TOC location.
rules.correctiveAction: If corrective action is necessary, you will be contacted. You should provide forms in the correct Module 1 location as specified in the applicable eCTD Backbone Files Specification for Module 1.
rules.guidanceSource: FDA Presentations; The eCTD Backbone Files Specification for Module 1

implementation.note: Dependency assessment 2026-11-25: criteria p.59 requires the actual application form to be in the location required by the applicable M1 specification. Current XML form groups explicitly permit attachments and supply candidate associations, not main-form content identity. Form-type metadata, filename, or group membership cannot identify every actual form, especially a form placed outside the expected group. Needs versioned content identity distinguishing main forms and attachments, followed by applicable location mapping. Existing 2045 metadata eligibility must not be relabeled as complete 5034 coverage. No implementation or qualification claimed; remains NotAssessed.

rules.description: PDF version of document is incorrect
rules.problem: You have submitted a document using a PDF version that is not consistent with ICH / regional guidance.
rules.correctiveAction: No corrective action is necessary. Modify your SOPs to ensure that documents in future submissions conform to the published standards.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; FDA Portable Document Format Specifications

implementation.note: Checks original ordinary-PDF headers 1.0-1.7 and optional direct Catalog Version names 1.4-1.7 using the later declaration, with exact current capture, successful parsing and both archived sources under PDF specification 4.1 from 2016-09-21. Key presence and raw name are separate; null, non-name, indirect and unknown values remain unknown. Parsed version must match the header or effective declaration. Extensions/Metadata remain unqualified. Versions 1.0-1.3 fail at Info; 1.4-1.7 satisfy this component only. Other catalog forms, PDF/A, actual feature conformance, history, non-PDF-named contents and earlier policy remain incomplete. Legacy evidence cannot authorize new conclusions. Final seven-class Windows regression 305/305, including 78 FDA5035 cases with 28 new cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Wrong application form
rules.problem: You have submitted the wrong application form based on your application type, that is, you have submitted a form named 1571.pdf for an NDA/ANDA/BLA, a form named 356h.pdf for an IND or a form named 2252.pdf for a sequence that is not an annual report.
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit your submission with the correct application form. You may resubmit using the original sequence number of the submission. Modify your SOPs to ensure that your submission has a the correct type of form correctly named 356h.pdf or 1571.pdf and referenced in the correct eCTD location.
rules.guidanceSource: FDA Presentations; FDA Form Instructions

implementation.note: Checks explicit exact-filename contradictions for current qualified form groups: 1571.pdf for NDA/ANDA/BLA, 356h.pdf for IND, and 2252.pdf for qualified nonannual starts. Adds six explicit starting combinations under captured M1 2.6 from 2025-03-31, requiring allowed application/type/subtype and submission-id/sequence equal to the current sequence; preserves the original-application branch. Application type, starting type/subtype and leaf operation/href require unique non-default original values matching normalized facts, with enumeration charged to the work budget. Unknown activity does not hide independent 1571/356h errors, and unknown references do not hide another qualified reference. Annual/follow-up/invalid combinations, default attributes, wrong namespace, absent source and inconsistent start identity remain unknown. Requires fixed-DTD connected XML, captured files, unique application association and archived dictionaries. URI aliases deduplicate per application/file; High/Error severity retained. Other nonannual scopes, actual form identity, names/locations, history and shared multi-application scope remain unqualified; no Pass. Final seven-class Windows regression 243/243, including 115 FDA5038 cases with 27 new raw-evidence cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: PDF does not have 'Fast Web Access' active
rules.problem: You have submitted a PDF that has been created without 'Fast Web Access' active.
rules.correctiveAction: Ensure that documents in future submissions are created with the 'Fast Web Access' option.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; ICH Q&A 36 #23

implementation.note: Detects either a missing Linearized key in a complete first dictionary or a separately typed complete non-dictionary first value (number, string, hex string, array, Boolean, name, null). Requires endobj plus its real delimiter within the first 1024 bytes, typed successful PDF processing, captured hash and archived FDA criteria. Uses Adobe PDF Reference 1.7 F.2.2 necessary conditions, not string search or Catalog lookup. Reader cancellation/input-change exceptions survive cursor-restoration failures; ordinary I/O remains unknown. The outer PDF adapter retains original input-change exceptions at its guarded stream boundary and rethrows before publishing facts or classifying ordinary parser failures. Streams, references, unsupported operators and incomplete objects remain unknown. Present declarations remain unverified. Hint streams/offsets, updates, history and non-PDF-named contents remain unqualified; no Pass. Final seven-class Windows regression 353/353, including 80 FDA5040 cases with 9 new terminal-read cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: PDF opening settings not optimal
rules.problem: You have submitted a PDF that does not open in the desired view.
rules.correctiveAction: Ensure that PDF Opening settings are correct for all future submissions. The initial view of the PDF files should be set as Bookmarks and Pages in the Navigation Panel. If there are no bookmarks, the initial view should be set to Pages only. PDFs should open in 'most recent view' (i.e. 'inherit zoom' for bookmarks and links, and 'default' in open dialogue box).
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; FDA Portable Document Format Specifications

implementation.note: Preserves qualified opening-panel checks and independent bookmark presence. Adds isolated direct OpenAction array Fit or positive finite XYZ magnification after complete page-tree and target-page qualification, excluding catalog AA/Names/AcroForm and page AA. XYZ zero/null retains zoom and is not a failure; named/action/indirect destinations, malformed parameters and unknown targets remain unknown. Exact capture, typed successful parsing, both archived sources and PDF 4.1 date from 2016-09-21 are required. Legacy three-field view facts cannot authorize zoom failures. Layout, other opening actions/destinations, uncertain outlines, history and non-PDF-named contents remain unqualified; no Pass. Final nine-class Windows regression 507/507, including 102 FDA5045 cases with 37 new cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Document has password protection
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that has password protection and cannot be opened. (Not applicable for FDA Forms)
rules.correctiveAction: Resubmit the protected file in a later submission referencing the original leaf using the operation attribute of "Replace."
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; ICH Q&A 36 #21

implementation.note: Dependency assessment 2026-11-25: criteria p.62 requires password protection preventing opening and explicitly excludes FDA Forms. PdfDocumentEncryptedException only establishes that encrypted content could not be decrypted; the current Encrypted category does not distinguish a required opening password, unsupported security handler, or malformed encryption data. Encryption presence/owner restrictions alone do not prove inability to open. Qualified actual FDA-form identity is also absent. Do not relabel FDA3102's encrypted/unknown classification or generic PDF-SECURITY findings as FDA5050. Requires typed opening-password evidence and qualified exception identity; no implementation or qualification claimed, remains NotAssessed.

rules.description: Document has annotations, only PDFs in module 1, section 1.15 are permitted to have annotations.
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that has PDF annotations, only PDFs in module 1, section 1.15 are permitted to have annotations.
rules.correctiveAction: Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have annotations, only PDFs in module 1, section 1.15 are permitted to have annotations..
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks identified markup in current captured PDFs referenced by qualified regional M1 leaves outside 1.15 or actual ICH module 2-5 leaves, including node extensions. Requires complete fixed-DTD unique connected XML, consistent element/leaf identity, href/location, exact PDF hash and successful processing. Active ownership leaves require unique non-default original ID/operation/href values matching derived facts, with enumeration charged to the location budget; unknown references do not hide independent qualified outside owners. One outside reference prevents whole-file exemption even when another is promotional; physical folders do not determine ownership. Missing/incomplete/duplicate backbone evidence cannot become NotApplicable merely because there is no PDF; an independently qualified outside reference still retains its failure. Links/widgets and unknown types are not proven markup. Other annotation semantics, historical/unreferenced contents and unresolved ownership remain unqualified. Final seven-class Windows regression 296/296, including 134 FDA5055 cases with 27 new raw-owner cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Document contains no text
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that is a scanned image only and is not text searchable.
rules.correctiveAction: Ensure that documents in future submissions are text searchable whenever possible (minimize the use of scanned documents).
rules.guidanceSource: FDA Portable Document Format Specifications

implementation.note: Checks independently qualified image-only current PDFs, not negated text extraction. Adds complete unfiltered Contents arrays with explicit line boundaries: every member is checked before ordered concatenation, graphics state/operands cross streams, repeated references count each use and all bytes share the one MiB page-content budget. Cancellation accompanying supplemental I/O or ordinary failure propagates; uncancelled ordinary failures and local limits remain unknown, while input changes and direct cancellation propagate. Text in any member, filtered/non-stream/unavailable members or ambiguous boundaries remain unknown. Requires complete q/Q/cm/Do grammar, balanced state, qualified Gray/RGB images, exact capture, successful processing and both archived sources under PDF 4.1 from 2016-09-21. Other encodings, nested content, OCR quality, forms/annotations/structure, history and earlier policy remain unqualified; no Pass. Final seven-class Windows regression 313/313, including 99 FDA5057 cases with 7 new cancellation/category cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Broken bookmark
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more bookmarks pointing to a file that does not exist.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have broken bookmarks.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks independently qualified GoToR bookmark file targets against explicitly selected current/history inventories. Includes XYZ destinations with nonnegative integer page, finite numeric/null coordinates and null/nonnegative finite zoom. File existence is independent of the separately qualified XYZ page-tree comparison in FDA5102. Shared target facts are tested for 5101 corruption separation and 5115 absolute paths. Requires complete outline identity, unambiguous action/filespec, exact capture and successful processing. Literal percent/hash characters are not URI-decoded; unselected history is unknown and existing unreadable files are not missing. Other actions/encodings and historical sources remain incomplete; no Pass. Its implementation increment passed 457/457 with 100 FDA5100 cases; the later FDA5102 increment passed 485/485 with the same 100 cases. Main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Corrupt bookmark
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more bookmarks pointing to a file that cannot be opened.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have corrupt bookmarks.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Associates independently qualified current GoToR bookmark file targets with existing selected current/history PDFs having exact capture-bound InvalidContent opening failures. Source and target consistency are independently required; either observation order is supported. Missing files, unselected history, generic parse errors, encryption, I/O and resource limits remain unknown. Shared budgets retain known findings without exceeding the allowance. Other actions/formats, historical source PDFs and complete parser qualification remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted. Final thirteen-class Windows regression 608/608, including 42 FDA5101 cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents.

rules.description: Bookmark has non-existent named destination or page
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more bookmarks pointing to a named destination or page that does not exist.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have bookmarks linking to non-existent pages or named destinations.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks qualified current GoToR Fit and XYZ bookmark zero-based indexes against independently qualified complete target page trees, with exact source/target capture binding. XYZ syntax requires nonnegative integer page, finite numeric/null coordinates and null/nonnegative finite zoom; magnification does not alter indexing. Target traversal still requires unique identities, consistent Parent links/subtree Counts and parsed-page agreement. Both observation orders, selected historical targets, exact allowance and cancellation retain known failure. Missing/unreadable targets, unselected history, malformed trees, legacy/conflicting counts and unbound hashes cannot prove absent pages. Named destinations, internal bookmarks, other modes and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass. Final ten-class Windows regression 485/485, including 78 FDA5102 cases with 28 new cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Multiple action bookmark
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more bookmarks containing multiple actions.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have bookmarks triggering multiple actions.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks independently qualified current bookmarks containing complete supported GoToR action chains. Adds XYZ throughout bookmark chains with nonnegative integer page, finite numeric/null coordinates and null/nonnegative finite zoom. Explicit XYZ enablement is limited to the bookmark caller; shared hyperlink action-chain behavior is unchanged. Requires exact capture, successful parsing, complete bounded outline/action identity and all action executions. Unknown/malformed tails, cycles, Dest/A conflicts and exhausted work/depth/link limits cannot publish partial counts; outline siblings are not actions. Other actions, encodings and historical sources remain incomplete; no Pass. Final eleven-class Windows regression 565/565, including 78 FDA5103 cases with 32 new cases and 48 unchanged hyperlink multi-action cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: External bookmark
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that makes reference to one or more external bookmarks (e.g. web links, email links).
rules.correctiveAction: Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have bookmarks that are external to the application.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A 64

implementation.note: Checks qualified current absolute HTTP/HTTPS/mailto URI bookmarks and simple ASCII relative paths under an explicit qualified HTTP/HTTPS Catalog Base. Base must be well formed with no userinfo, percent escapes, query or fragment; missing/wrong/unresolved Base and ambiguous relative forms remain unknown. Absolute URI classification is independent of Base. Complete outline/action identity, exact capture and successful parsing remain required. Local parsing only, no target requests; new evidence retains Web/Email category without original or combined addresses. Other relative forms, schemes/actions, cross-application files, historical sources and complete ICH Q&A 64 qualification remain incomplete; no Pass. Final eleven-class Windows regression 603/603, including 83 FDA5105 cases with 40 new cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Inactive bookmark
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that has one or more inactive bookmarks.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have inactive bookmarks.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks qualified current childless bookmarks with absent A/Dest/AA/SE/First/Last and absent or direct integer zero Count. Count metadata does not activate an item. Complete bounded outline identity, exact capture and successful parsing remain required; zero cannot bypass action/child keys or inconsistent tree identity. Nonzero/null/indirect/malformed counts, null or unresolved actions and parent headings remain unknown. Other inactive semantics, historical sources and non-PDF-named contents remain incomplete; no Pass. Final ten-class Windows regression 581/581, including 62 FDA5110 cases with 24 new cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Non-relative bookmark
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that has one or more non- relative (absolute) bookmarks.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions have only relative bookmarks.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; FDA Portable Document Format Specifications; ICH Q&A 36 #23

implementation.note: Checks independently qualified current GoToR bookmarks with literal slash-rooted absolute file specifications, exact capture and consistent successful parsing. Does not URI-decode, trim, use OS path rules or access the target. Findings retain classification rather than the original path. URI actions, platform/drive variants, other encodings/actions, historical sources and complete referenced-guidance qualification remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted. Final eighteen-class Windows regression 827/827, including 43 FDA5115 cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents.

rules.description: Bookmark does not 'Inherit Zoom'
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more bookmarks that are not set to 'Inherit Zoom'.
rules.correctiveAction: Ensure that all bookmarks are set to 'Inherit Zoom'.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; FDA Portable Document Format Specifications; Final Guidance for Industry: Providing Regulatory Submissions in Electronic Format--Human Pharmaceutical Applications and Related Submissions Using the eCTD Specifications

implementation.note: Checks qualified current GoToR Fit and positive XYZ zoom, now including simple Filespec dictionaries with nonempty ASCII F and matching optional UF. Platform/URL/embedded/related-file keys, conflicting or unresolved identities and malformed destinations remain unknown. Exact capture, complete outline/action identity, consistent parsing, archived criteria and PDF 4.1 date are required. XYZ zero/null retains zoom. Unresolved F/UF may be rejected by the base parser; direct supplemental-reader controls independently reject these identities. Internal/named destinations, other modes/actions/encodings, historical sources and earlier policy remain incomplete; no Pass. Final ten-class Windows regression 614/614, including 87 FDA5117 cases with 33 new cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; still Partial.

rules.description: Broken hyperlink
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more hyperlinks pointing to a file that does not exist.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have broken hyperlinks.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Checks independently qualified current page-Link GoToR file targets absent from explicitly selected current/history inventories. Requires qualified complete page tree, unique indirect annotation ownership, valid nondegenerate rectangle, consistent page owner, unambiguous action/file specification and exact source capture. Fit and valid five-item XYZ qualify file identity. Unselected history is unknown; existing unreadable files are not missing. Literal file specifications are not URI-decoded. Other actions, annotation/specification variants, historical source PDFs and non-PDF-named contents remain unqualified; no Pass is emitted. Second-round ten-class Windows regression 474/474, including 97 FDA5200 cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents; subsequent XYZ page-index qualification is recorded under FDA5202.

rules.description: Corrupt link
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more links pointing to a file that cannot be opened.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have corrupt links.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Qualified current page-Link GoToR references are associated with independently capture-bound existing PDFs having typed definite content-format opening failures. Either observation order and shared limits retain known failure. Missing files, unselected history, generic parse errors, encryption, I/O and resource limits do not prove corruption. Other actions/formats, annotation variants, historical source PDFs and complete parser qualification remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted.

rules.description: Link has non-existent named destination or page
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more hyperlinks pointing to a named destination or page that does not exist.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have links pointing to non-existent pages or named destinations.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Qualified current page-Link GoToR Fit/XYZ zero-based indexes are compared with independently capture-bound complete target PDF page trees, supporting either observation order and shared budgets. XYZ requires five items, finite numeric or null coordinates and null or finite nonnegative zoom. Missing/unreadable files, legacy page counts and unselected history do not prove absent pages. Named destinations, internal hyperlinks, other modes/actions, annotation variants and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted. Second-round ten-class Windows regression 506/506, including 83 FDA5202 cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents.

rules.description: Multiple action hyperlink
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more hyperlinks containing multiple actions.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have links triggering multiple actions.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Independent qualified current page-Link identity and complete bounded GoToR action-chain counts establish multiple actions. Fit and valid five-item XYZ destinations are supported throughout the chain. Complete page/annotation inventory, unique ownership and capture binding are required. Separate annotations, bookmarks and opening actions are not combined. Unknown/cyclic/malformed/conflicting chains, other action/file/destination types, annotation variants and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted. Second-round eleven-class Windows regression 622/622, including 86 FDA5203 cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents.

rules.description: External hyperlink
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that makes reference to one or more web references in a hyperlink (e.g. web links, email links).
rules.correctiveAction: Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have hyperlinks that are external to the application.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH Q&A 64

implementation.note: Independent qualified current page-Link absolute HTTP/HTTPS/mailto URI actions and simple ASCII relative paths with explicit qualified HTTP/HTTPS Catalog Base establish external Web/Email hyperlinks. Base userinfo, percent escapes, query and fragment are not qualified, and no document-location base is inferred. Complete page/annotation inventory, unique ownership and capture binding are required. No network request or original address is retained in new regulatory evidence. Other relative/Base forms, schemes/actions, cross-application files, annotation variants and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted. Second-round ten-class Windows regression 578/578, including 80 FDA5205 cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents.

rules.description: Inactive hyperlink
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that has one or more inactive hyperlinks.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have inactive hyperlinks.
rules.guidanceSource: General good practice to ensure reviewability.

implementation.note: Qualified current page-Link annotations with explicitly absent action/destination/additional-action keys and absent or direct nonnegative integer StructParent establish inactivity. StructParent is structure metadata, not activation; structure-tree validity is not established. Complete page/annotation inventory, unique ownership and capture binding are required. Explicit nulls, unresolved or unsupported actions, other structure-index forms, annotation variants, other inactive semantics and historical source PDFs remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted. Second-round ten-class Windows regression 602/602, including 67 FDA5210 cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents.

rules.description: Non-relative hyperlink
rules.problem: You have submitted a document that has one or more non- relative (absolute) hyperlinks.
rules.correctiveAction: Corrective action may be necessary and you will be contacted if it is necessary. Ensure that documents in future submissions do not have non-relative hyperlinks.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; FDA Portable Document Format Specifications; ICH Q&A 36 #23

implementation.note: Qualified current page-Link GoToR slash-rooted absolute file specifications establish non-relative links. Source page and capture qualification are required. Literal file values are not URI-decoded, trimmed or interpreted with local OS rules; findings retain classification only. URI/platform/drive variants, other encodings/actions, annotation variants, historical sources and complete referenced-guidance qualification remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted.

rules.description: Link does not 'Inherit Zoom'
rules.problem: You have submitted a document with one or more links that are not set to 'Inherit Zoom'.
rules.correctiveAction: Ensure that all links in future submissions are set to 'Inherit Zoom'.
rules.guidanceSource: ICH eCTD Specification V3.2.2; FDA Portable Document Format Specifications; Final Guidance for Industry: Providing Regulatory Submissions in Electronic Format--Human Pharmaceutical Applications and Related Submissions Using the eCTD Specifications

implementation.note: Qualified current page-Link GoToR Fit and positive fixed XYZ zoom settings establish non-inheritance under both archived sources and PDF4.1 qualification from 2016-09-21. Simple ASCII file specifications and unambiguous Filespec dictionaries with matching optional UF are supported; platform, embedded and related-file variants are excluded. XYZ zero/null retains current magnification and is not a violation. Internal/named destinations, other view modes/actions/file encodings, annotation variants, historical sources and earlier policy remain incomplete; no Pass is emitted. Second-round eleven-class Windows regression 725/725, including 93 FDA5217 cases, and main-agent bounded read-only review passed without subagents.

effectiveDatePolicy: effectiveDateRaw is authoritative. A null effectiveOn with a dated qualifier means multiple applicability dates, not TBD; 1734/1735/1736 retain the CBER Module 4 date separately in raw text. These rules are not executable in this batch.
